name: Dreamix
description:
About This Game

You can join our Discord server to get access to the Dreamix Playtest Build:

If you are a Chinese player or you use QQ, you are more than welcome to join our QQ group (557845023) for the playtest access instead.

Dreamix is a card game centered around small stat values and compact, cycle-focused decks.

In Dreamix, everything revolves around cycles: the looping card carousel, recurring hand cards, and looping maps. Grow stronger within each cycle, conquer dream after dream.

Game Features:

  • Cyclical Progression on the Board

Advance across looping dream boards: your hand cards affect far more than combat — they directly determine how many steps you may move on the grid. As your run unfolds, you’ll unlock upgraded tiles and encounter a vast array of foes and random events.

  • Unique Card Mechanics

    Every card comes with three variable stat slots. Each time you draw a card, one value is randomly assigned, and the card’s power scales entirely with this rolled number.

  • Ever-Cycling Hand System

    Traditional draw and discard piles are discarded entirely. In Dreamix, your full deck stays accessible at all times! All cards circulate between your active hand and reserve zone. Choose to play cards immediately, or swap them with reserves to gamble for greater rewards — every choice is yours to command.

  • Limitless Card Fusion

    Your deck caps at only 10 cards total. When acquiring new cards, fuse any two together to craft a single, far stronger card. This unique upgrade system lets you amplify one stat’s potency or stack the combined effects of both fused cards. Experiment with countless fusion combinations to unlock endless strategic possibilities.

  • Distinct Out-of-Run Progression

    After clearing each dream run, you may memorize one card. This unique card is permanently stored in your Memory Library. Outside of your dream cycles, you can recall and slot it into your deck to tackle high-difficulty challenge battles, unlocking richer rewards in the process!

    Embark to Conquer the Looping Dreams!
